title: Rome Turns East
objective: After this level you can describe how Rome came to dominate Greece and the Hellenistic kingdoms.
summary: Rome beat Macedon and came to control Greece, destroying Corinth in 146 BCE. Meanwhile Greek culture conquered Rome from within.

cards.headline: Rome conquered Greece. Then Greece conquered Rome right back.
Wars with Macedon
cards.body: In a series of wars against the kingdom of Macedon, ending in 148 BCE, Rome came to control Greece. In 196 BCE the Roman general Flamininus had proclaimed the Greek cities free. Yet Roman influence over them only kept growing.

cards.headline: Captive Greece
cards.body: Greek art, literature and philosophy deeply shaped Roman culture. Wealthy Romans learned Greek, hired Greek tutors and copied Greek statues. The poet Horace later wrote that captive Greece took its fierce conqueror captive.

cards.context: In the same year that Carthage fell, Rome also destroyed the great and wealthy Greek city of Corinth.

cards.headline: The east: won
learned: Rome defeated Macedon and controlled Greece
Flamininus proclaimed the Greeks free in 196 BCE
